messages:
sam: FYI planning a cautious v2 rollout tonight in the low-traffic window (01:00-02:00 UTC). Plan: canary 10% -> 30% over 25m. Feature flag: v2-negotiation. No schema changes. Pause if client pin spikes or heartbeat errors appear.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: roll-2025-01-12-v2. Canary 10% for 10m then to 30% over 15m. auto-throttle=true. Metrics prefix: telemetry.v2.roll. Link: https://deploys.internal/roll-2025-01-12-v2

nina: Quick doc ask 1: do we need to call out that header pins in custom tenants will stay pinned? I can add a short note.

sam: Yes, call out sticky routing: tenants pinned-to-v1 remain routed to v1 for 24h after rollout unless unpinned. Also mention operator note: do not evict active sessions.

dave: Rollback/abort criteria so oncall can act?

sam: Abort rules:
- Pause progression if error_rate(v2) > error_rate(v1) + 0.35% for 3m
- Auto-throttle (hold) if error delta between 0.15%-0.35% for 10m and send page
- Full rollback if error_rate delta > 0.9% for 3m OR p95 latency degrades >40% for 5m
Manual rollback cmd:
```
deployctl rollback --id roll-2025-01-12-v2 --reason "canary-failure"
```

maria: Can deploy-bot do incremental steps of +5% when in throttled mode instead of stopping entirely? That helps investigation.

sam: Yes, setting auto-throttle to reduce step-size to 5% and notify #oncall. If throttled state persists >20m, escalate to owner.

deploy-bot: roll-2025-01-12-v2 configured: canary=10%, next=30%, auto-throttle=true, small-steps-on-throttle=5%. Telemetry will emit to telemetry.prod.v2.roll.*

nina: I'll update release notes: one line: "Server: v2 header negotiation opt-in; tenants pinned to v1 will be respected. Operators: watch client_pin_ratio and heartbeat errors." Linking PR when done.

sam: Hand-off in #releases-handoff at 00:55 UTC. Jamie will monitor first 30m. If client_pin_ratio for v1 > 2% pause and notify account teams.

dave: I'll post dashboard queries for error_rate, p50/p95, client_pin_ratio, heartbeat-failures before handoff.

maria: ack. Will be oncall for the window.

sam: Thanks team. If anything looks odd, call it out immediately and choose throttle -> pause -> rollback in that order unless quarantine triggers. :thumbsup:
